The change v0.1.87 described, actually shipped.

## Server

### Fixed
- v0.1.87's release notes described the forced-save change, but that build carried only the version bump; the source edit had not applied. This build carries it: the five-minute forced save no longer fires when the game's active slot file changed within the last ten minutes, and the log says so once (`periodic SaveToDisk yielding`).
